business_summary.text: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited is a prepared foods company serving retail and foodservice customers across global markets, with a focus on authentic, convenient and innovative food solutions.

call_points.text: Management expects continued momentum in Third-Party Business and recovery in Affiliates Business to drive future growth.
No specific capex guidance provided, but continued investments in Cheffin and HoReCa businesses are expected.
Cheffin business has benefited from learnings on Amazon and expansion into quick commerce through Zepto.
Margins are under pressure due to inflationary costs from geopolitical developments, but cost optimization measures are being implemented.
Company maintains a debt-free status and strong cash position to support future growth.
External geopolitical developments and inflationary pressures pose risks to margins and profit growth.

timeline.summary: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited reported Q1FY27 results with revenue growing 29% YoY to ₹161.6 Cr and PAT growing 8% YoY to ₹8.8 Cr, driven by strong recovery in Affiliates business (+46% YoY) and continued momentum in Third-Party business (+15% YoY).
